gallery.title: Digital-zero run and values outside declared limits
gallery.facts: FP1–F7: 102 consecutive digital-zero samples within the original two-second excerpt. Calibrated value 0.195360 µV, not physical zero. Several source channels exceed EDF header-declared limits. This does not establish ADC clipping or its cause.
gallery.question: Identify reliable/unreliable intervals and possible acquisition/export explanations. What evidence distinguishes them?

gallery.title: Matched comparison for A01
gallery.facts: Same recording, 120 seconds earlier. In the selected FP1–F7 excerpt, the longest equal-value run is 4 samples; longest digital-zero run is 1. This is a comparison, not a confirmed normal EEG.
gallery.question: Does this comparison support a measurable distinction? Specify morphology, leads and counterexamples.

gallery.title: Posterior digital-zero runs
gallery.facts: P4–O2 and P8–O2 contain 485 and 446 consecutive digital zeros in the original 512-sample excerpts. Runs begin at the excerpt boundary; these are not full run durations. No declared-limit exceedance in those excerpts.
gallery.question: Assess onset, recovery and spatial distribution. Can recording behavior be distinguished from a physiological interpretation?

gallery.title: Rounded waveform comparison for A03
gallery.facts: Selected P7–O1 excerpt: longest equal-value run 5 samples, digital-zero run 2; no declared-limit exceedance. This later comparison has a different personal model/history version; score differences cannot be attributed to morphology alone.
gallery.question: Is this morphology distinct from the constant segments in A03? Describe without assuming an alarm outcome.

gallery.title: Previously verified multi-lead digital-zero runs
gallery.facts: The previously checked two-second excerpt contains digital-zero runs in multiple leads. Their presence alone has not established an alarm rejection rule. Review the broader context before proposing a cause.
gallery.question: Are the runs synchronous? Which leads and exact intervals are interpretable? What additional evidence is needed?

cohort: M677 strict short15; full 23-group / 135-target replay; no alarm-layer simulated feedback
selection: Every emitted short15 alarm, including protected/unscored alarms; no outcome-based omission.
limits: Outcome-masked retrospective expert review, not independent validation. POST and anomaly gallery are retrospective only.
